# CNC Display CRT to LCD Upgrade Solutions
> Kongto Technology provides plug-and-play industrial LCD replacement modules for aging CRT displays on FANUC, Mitsubishi, Siemens, Mazak, Okuma, and HAAS CNC machines. Direct fit, no wiring modifications, 2-year warranty.
